page.layout: One page of text, one column; margin notes in the right margin (three short italic notes beside the first lines of the paragraph). Running head at top, page number at top right, heading below the running head, catchword "Quv" at the foot right.

main_text.head: CONFLICTATIO CONSTANTISSIMI IN CHRISTO MARTYRIS, GVILHELMI THORPI ANGLI CVM PROCERIBVS ECCLESIASTICIS, DE CAVSA RELIGIONIS EXAMINATI AC CONDEMNATI.
main_text.p: GVILIELMVS THORPVS, sacrificus, quo tempore sustinenda erat causae suae actio, prius ab iis, quos in Christo habebat familiares, obnixe astipulatus est, ut singula quae agerentur, diligenter annotata, literis consignarent, in communē caeterorum confirmationem. Thomas Arūdellus Archiepiscopus Cantuariensis. Eductus itaque e vinculis carcerariis (apud Saltuuodenses custoditus est) Anno 1407, dominica a vinculis Petri proxima, coram archiepiscopo Thoma Arundello sistitur, qui tum & Apostolicus legatus, & Regius Cancellarius summus quippe eius Insulae magistratus, erat. Hic semotis laicis, ac arbitris, solus cum Maluereno quodam Londini tum

page.notes: Gothic initial G in "GVILIELMVS" is a large woodcut initial. Right margin notes read "Thomas", "Arūdellus", "Archiepi-scopus Cantuariensis", partly damaged. Page is faint in places; the running head reads "STASTICAE" as printed and may be a misprint for "SYSTASTICAE". Heading lines are partly ambiguous and the first word of the heading reads "CONFLICTATIO" as printed.
